scope.original: Original broad-distribution chosen step-20000 weights, before every small-layout structure experiment.
scope.new_weights: All 48 budget-ending weights: 40 path/branch/refinement/replay/A-D/G-E-F experimental weights plus eight matched broad/graph mixture weights. Intermediate and best-validation snapshots are not additional experiment arms.
scope.grouping: Marginal layout, target, exact integer parent-distance layer and overlapping action-branch types; shortest action and complete strict candidate order reported separately. Counts are paired, not independent trials.
scope.prediction: Same shared Q encoder and directed_max, every legal candidate, fixed argmin tie behavior. Encode each fixed endpoint once in batches; tiny numerical differences at near ties can change a few of 693100 choices versus earlier QCache batches.
scope.retention: Fixed 4068 allowed finite training pairs and 4096 allowed training decisions from 128 original training layouts, excluding ALL 16 small-study layouts. Diagnosis only, not unseen-layout validation.
scope.successor_gap_1: No finite legal sibling pair differs by one step in this fixed bank. A grid move flips player parity, so sibling-to-fixed-goal finite distances have equal parity; gap2 is the smallest nonzero sibling gap here. Parent-child optimal gap1 and same-goal cross-start gap1 remain separate diagnostics.
scope.chosen_branch_types: Disjoint chosen optimal/recoverable/dead action crossed with walk/push. Matrix rows are original chosen type; columns are new chosen type. Distinct from overlapping available-branch strata.
